kits.name: The Courthouse Wedding Kit
kits.headline: Every step of a courthouse wedding, on paper.
kits.promise: A 12-page printable kit for a courthouse wedding: the license steps in order, the questions to ask your county clerk, a witness and ID list, the courthouse-day timeline, a small reception plan, a budget page and the name-change checklist.
includes: License and paperwork checklist, step by step
Questions to call the county clerk, with space for the answers
Courthouse-day timeline and what to bring
Small reception plan and guest list
After the wedding: certified copies and name change
kits.limits: It states no county's fees or rules as fact. Rules differ by county and change, so the kit gives you the questions and your county clerk gives you the answers.

kits.name: The Wedding Vows Workbook
kits.headline: From a blank page to vows you can say out loud.
kits.promise: A 12-page printable workbook for writing your vows: decide the basics together, memory and promise prompts, a five-part structure, three fill-in templates, a length and timing guide, a read-aloud practice log and two cut-out vow cards.
includes: Three fill-in templates: classic, story-led, short and sweet
kits.limits: It helps you write your own vows; it does not write them for you. Follow any guidance your officiant or venue gives on length or content.

kits.name: The Maid of Honor Kit
kits.headline: Everything you are asked to carry, organized.
kits.promise: A 13-page printable kit for a maid of honor: a duties timeline from engagement to wedding day, questions to ask the couple, shower and bachelorette planners, a budget split sheet, a speech builder and the day-of emergency kit list.
includes: Duties timeline, engagement to wedding day
Shower planner and guest and gift tracker
Speech builder, prompts, draft page and practice log
kits.limits: Every couple sets its own expectations for the role; the kit starts with the questions to agree them.
